### 1. Please acknowledge in the limitations that positive and negative affect were assessed using a continuous scale. There is evidence to suggest that positive and negative affect are separate, though highly correlated, constructs; therefore, using continuous scale may overlook some of the nuanced ways in which affect is associated with other constructs.

We now address this as a limitation in our discussion. See paragraph starting on line 744.
